AIModel.docstring: Abstract base class for AI models.

AgentActor.docstring:
Executes tasks and manages tool operations via a ToolServer.

Integrates with AgentMemory to track task history and PerformanceMonitor to log execution metrics.
Tasks may include executing Python code, shell commands, or using specialized tools.

PluginInterface.docstring:
Example plugin interface.
Concrete plugins should subclass this interface and implement `execute(command)`.

AIAgent.docstring:
AIAgent manages a collection of plugins. Each plugin provides certain
capabilities (e.g., debugging, quick fixes, memory management).
The agent acts as a central dispatcher for plugin commands.

AgentRegistry.docstring: Manages the registration, retrieval, and lifecycle of AI agents dynamically.

DebugAgent.docstring:
An AI-driven Debugging Agent that orchestrates:
- Automated test runs
- Failure parsing
- Quick & adaptive fixes
- Version control interactions
- Debugging progress reports

CustomAgent.docstring:
CustomAgent is a flexible AI agent that:
  - Processes interactive queries with memory-based responses.
  - Handles custom-defined tasks via a simple task interface.
  - Learns from interactions by storing context for future use.

AIAgentWithMemory.docstring:
AIAgentWithMemory represents an AI agent that:
  - Interacts with users.
  - Retains memory of past conversations.
  - Provides context-aware responses.
  - Self-improves based on performance metrics.

Integrates:
  - MemoryManager for handling conversation memory.
  - PerformanceMonitor for tracking performance.
  - AIModelManager for selecting and managing AI models dynamically.

JournalAgent.docstring:
AI-powered agent for managing dev logs & blog entries.

✅ Auto-generates structured dev logs from debugging sessions.
✅ Summarizes issues, fixes, and key improvements for documentation.
✅ Exports Markdown-formatted dev blogs for easy publishing.

DeepSeekModel.docstring:
DeepSeek AI model wrapper for generating debugging patches.
- Uses DeepSeek AI locally or via CLI.
- Falls back to OpenAI GPT-4 if DeepSeek fails.
- Retries failed patches with slight modifications.
- Validates AI patches before applying them.
- Tracks which AI model generates the best patches.

ErrorDetector.docstring:
Class for detecting and classifying errors in Python code.
Supports syntax error detection, runtime error handling, 
and logic error identification through static analysis.

MyAIModel.docstring:
A simple implementation of the AIModel abstract base class.
This model returns a basic fix suggestion based on the error type.

OpenAIModel.docstring:
OpenAI GPT-4 model wrapper for generating debugging patches.
- Uses OpenAI GPT-4 Turbo to generate patches.
- Retries failed patches with slight modifications.
- Validates AI patches before applying them.
- Tracks which AI settings generate the best patches.

OllamaModel.docstring:
AI model integration for Ollama.

Based on the output of:
  (base) PS D:\AgentProject> ollama list
  NAME                     ID              SIZE      MODIFIED    
  deepseek-coder:latest    3ddd2d3fc8d2    776 MB    8 days ago
  deepseek-r1:latest       0a8c26691023    4.7 GB    11 days ago
  mistral:latest           f974a74358d6    4.1 GB    11 days ago

You can select the appropriate model. For instance, to use the 'mistral:latest' model,
initialize the class as follows:

    ollama = OllamaModel("ollama run mistral:latest")

AgentPlanner.docstring:
The AgentPlanner class organizes tasks by dividing them into prioritized subtasks and creating milestones
based on customizable criteria or predefined intervals.

AgentBase.docstring:
AgentBase serves as a comprehensive base class for all AI-driven agents.
It integrates:
    - Task scheduling (cron-based)
    - Structured logging (via LoggerManager)
    - Memory management (optional)
    - Performance monitoring (optional)
    - Dynamic plugin support
    - Error handling
    - Chain-of-thought reasoning (optional)

Subclasses must implement the abstract method `solve_task` to define task-specific logic.

ProfessorSynapseAgent.docstring:
🧙🏾‍♂️ Professor Synapse - A reasoning AI that evolves through learning, forecasting,
and knowledge-based reasoning.

Inherits from AgentBase and extends its functionality with:
  - Memory management via MemoryEngine.
  - Forecasting capabilities using GPTForecaster.
  - A knowledge graph maintained with GraphMemory.
  - Real-time data retrieval through APIClient.

ExternalAIAdapter.docstring:
Adapter for a third-party AI model.

Wraps API calls to the external AI model and conforms to the AgentBase interface.

AIClient.docstring:
AIClient extends AgentBase to integrate AI-driven debugging, model management, and agent interactions.

✅ Supports multiple AI models (Mistral, DeepSeek, OpenAI).
✅ Manages AI confidence scores and patch tracking.
✅ Uses AI-generated patches for debugging automation.
✅ Self-improvement via error tracking and AI patch refinement.
✅ Supports scheduled AI-based tasks.

TbowTacticAgent.docstring: AI-driven trading agent that analyzes market trends and generates Tbow Tactic trade strategies.

TradingAgent.docstring:
A Trading Agent that executes trades using the Alpaca API or simulates trades in test mode.

A scanner that detects MACD curl setups for trading strategies and provides
additional analytical metrics.

Features:

- Identifies support & resistance levels.

The AlertManager class provides various alerting mechanisms for error detection,

AnalyticsManager.docstring:
Tracks AI debugging performance, patch success rates, and error analytics.

✅ Patch success/failure tracking
✅ Confidence score analysis

✅ JSON-based reporting for visualization

DebuggingStrategy.docstring:
The DebuggingStrategy class orchestrates an automated debugging system that:
  - Detects and fixes structured issues using AST manipulations.
  - Leverages AI-generated patches for more complex issues.
  - Maintains a JSON-based learning database to store successful patches.
  - Validates, applies, and can roll back patches.
  - Detects import errors and suggests solutions.

Typical usage:
  1. Instantiate DebuggingStrategy.
  2. Call generate_patch() for a given error.
  3. Apply the generated patch using apply_patch().

DebuggerBase.docstring:
Base class for Debugger components (CLI, Dashboard, or Plugins) that provides:

- JSON file handling (load, save, update)
- Thread-safe operations for debugging data

Generates and manages debugging session reports.

Features:

  - Saves the debugging report locally in a JSON file.
  - Optionally sends the report via email.

DebuggerLogger.docstring:
Logs debugging attempts, including patch attempts, failures, and successes.

✅ Stores logs in memory and appends them to a persistent log file.
✅ Recovers past logs from file upon initialization.

DebuggerDashboard.docstring:
PyQt5 GUI for an AI Debugging System that includes live patch tracking,
automated fixing, undo/rollback, Git auto-commit, and structured debugging reports.

DebuggingStrategy.docstring:
The DebuggingStrategy class orchestrates an automated debugging system that:
  - Detects and fixes structured issues (e.g., missing methods) using AST manipulations.
  - Leverages AI-generated patches for more complex issues.
  - Maintains a learning database to store successful patches for reuse.
  - Validates new patches, applies them conditionally, and can roll back if needed.
  - Detects and provides solutions for import errors.

Typical usage involves:
  1. Instantiating DebuggingStrategy.
  2. Using `generate_patch` to create a patch for a given error.
  3. Using `apply_patch` to apply and validate the generated patch.

DebuggerCLI.docstring:
Command-line interface for managing and executing debugging operations.
Inherits common JSON loading/saving and logging functionality from DebuggerBase.

DebuggingOrchestrator.docstring:
A central controller for managing AI-assisted debugging sessions.

✅ Integrates AI-driven debugging and journal tracking.
✅ Logs detailed debugging workflows and resolution tracking.
✅ Automates AI-driven patch management.

SandboxedPythonAgent.docstring: Python agent that executes code within a Docker container for sandboxing.

DebuggerRunner.docstring:
Manages the AI-assisted debugging workflow by:
- Running tests (`pytest`).
- Tracking errors (`PatchTrackingManager`).
- Applying AI-driven fixes (`AIConfidenceManager`).
- Retrying tests based on AI confidence scoring.

ProjectContextAnalyzer.docstring:
Analyzes the project structure, detects redundant imports, identifies duplicate logic,
and suggests opportunities for file integration.

This plugin scans the project for Python files, extracts class and function definitions,
detects duplicate definitions, and analyzes import usage. It can be used to boost
the overall quality and maintainability of the agent system.

FileSorterPlugin.docstring: AI-powered agent plugin that categorizes, moves, and detects duplicate files.

VectorMemoryManager.docstring:
An advanced MemoryManager that stores embeddings for semantic/long-term search.

This implementation computes and stores normalized embeddings using an embedding model.
It uses cosine similarity for search queries.

StructuredMemorySegment.docstring:
A structured memory record that stores text, metadata, tags, or embeddings
for advanced retrieval or classification.

AIConfidenceManager.docstring:
Manages confidence levels for AI-generated patches.

✅ Tracks patch success rates over time.
✅ Assigns confidence scores based on historical performance, patch length, and simulated complexity.
✅ Prevents retrying known bad patches.
✅ Suggests reattempting patches if confidence improves.

AgentMemory.docstring:
Manages AI memory storage and retrieval for past interactions.
Stores conversations in a JSON file per project.

AIDebuggingAnalytics.docstring:
Tracks AI debugging performance, including:
- Import fix success rates
- AI feedback scores

AgentPlugin.docstring:
Abstract base class for all agent plugins.

Attributes:
    name (str): The plugin name.
    memory_manager (Any): The memory management component.
    performance_monitor (Any): The performance tracking system.
    dispatcher (Any): Handles task execution requests.

AIPatchManager.docstring:
Unified class that consolidates AI-assisted patch management functionalities:
  - Auto-fixing errors via AutoFixManager
  - Analyzing error signatures and applying heuristic corrections
  - Generating AI patch suggestions (using local LLMs and OpenAI)
  - Refining and retrying patch applications
  - Reviewing, ranking, and analyzing patches via AIPatchReviewManager

TaskManager.docstring: Manages task execution for the ReasonerController, including asynchronous processing.

ExecutionSandbox.docstring: Manages a secure, restricted execution environment for Python code.

PerformanceMonitor.docstring:
Tracks and analyzes the performance of agents.
Logs successes and failures to identify areas for improvement.

AIModelManager.docstring:
A Unified AI Debugging System that selects the best available model.

Features:
✅ Adaptive AI Model Selection (Mistral → DeepSeek → OpenAI)
✅ AI Confidence Tracking (Assigns confidence scores to patches)
✅ AI Patch History (Avoids repeating bad patches)
✅ Auto-Retries if AI improves confidence
✅ File Backup & Rollback in case of failure
✅ Persistent Model Data Storage

AIPatchOptimizer.docstring:
AI-driven patch optimization system.

✅ Dynamically modifies failed patches based on AI heuristics.
✅ Prevents retrying low-confidence patches.
✅ If AI confidence improves, it re-applies the modified patch.

AutoFixer.docstring:
Automatically fixes known errors using:
  - Quick pattern-based fixes,
  - Known fixes from the learning DB,
  - LLM-based patch generation.

AIRefactorAgent.docstring:
A class-based AI refactoring agent that interacts with the Ollama AI model to 
analyze and refactor Python code.

Features:
- Calls AI via the Ollama CLI
- Handles AI call retries with Tenacity
- Parses AI responses as structured JSON
- Supports file-level and function-level refactoring

AIPatchUtils.docstring:
AI-based debugging assistant for generating patch suggestions.
Supports Ollama, DeepSeek, and OpenAI as fallback options.

AIPatchReviewManager.docstring:
Manages AI-based patch reviews, ranking, and tracking of past success rates.

Features:
- AI evaluation of patches for ranking.
- Tracks AI decisions & logs patch attempts.
- Analyzes failure trends to improve AI debugging.

AutoFixManager.docstring:
Consolidated manager that handles automatic fixes using:
  - Quick pattern-based fixes (e.g., missing attributes, import errors).
  - Learned fixes from a learning database.
  - LLM-generated patches.

BasicChainOfThoughtReasoner.docstring:
A basic chain-of-thought plugin that processes user queries or tasks in multiple steps,
capturing intermediate reasoning steps, and then returns a final answer.

Example usage:
    reasoner = BasicChainOfThoughtReasoner(capture_intermediate_steps=True)
    reasoner.execute("Solve the math problem: 3 + 5 * 2")

AdvancedChainOfThoughtReasoner.docstring:
Implements advanced chain-of-thought reasoning by decomposing tasks into semantic steps,
supporting hierarchical reasoning, contextual memory, and dynamic step adjustment.

PluginInterface.docstring: Minimal plugin interface if not already defined.

DebugAgentUtils.docstring:
A collection of advanced debugging and AI-driven fix utilities.

Features:
- Chunk-based code splitting for large LLM inputs
- Multi-model AI analysis with fallback (ollama, deepseek, openai)
- Unified diff-based patch parsing & line-level patch application
- Git-based rollback with optional backup
- Queuing additional agents for deeper AI-driven debugging

CodeIntegrationAnalyzerPlugin.docstring:
AI-powered agent plugin that scans Python files to detect:
- Duplicate imports across multiple files
- Opportunities to consolidate shared logic into common modules
- Unused or redundant imports

DatabaseManager.docstring:
A class to manage database interactions for AI refactoring suggestions.

Features:
- Initializes the database and creates necessary tables.
- Saves AI-generated refactor suggestions.
- Retrieves and updates human feedback.

DebugAgentAutoFixer.docstring:
AI-driven automated debugging system.

Key Features:
  ✅ AI Confidence-Driven Patch Retries.
  ✅ Auto-creation of missing modules.
  ✅ Secure backup & rollback system.
  ✅ Syntax error detection.
  ✅ Regex-powered unterminated string fixes.

DebuggerReporter.docstring:

- Tracks AI-generated patches and failures.
- Saves debugging session reports.
- Optionally sends email reports for review.

- Uses TLS authentication for security.
- Supports JSON-based email report content.
- Logs email status for debugging purposes.

LoggerManager.docstring:
A unified logging manager for AI agents and debugging tools.

Features:
- UTF-8 support for special characters (Windows fix).
- Ensures logs are stored in a **single 'logs/' directory**.
- Uses **rotating log files** (max 5MB per file, keeps 3 backups).
- Supports **dynamic log level updates** at runtime.
- **Singleton logger instance** to prevent duplicate handlers.

ReasonerController.docstring: Handles reasoning tasks for the TaskManager.

ProjectContextAnalyzer.docstring:
Analyzes a Python project structure, detects redundant imports, 
identifies duplicate logic, and suggests optimizations.

🔹 Features:
  ✅ Scans directories & extracts **function/class structure**.
  ✅ Detects **duplicate functions** across multiple files.
  ✅ Analyzes **redundant/missing imports**.
  ✅ Suggests **module integration opportunities**.
  ✅ Saves **full project analysis report** to JSON.

RollbackManager.docstring:
Automates the rollback and retry process for failed patches.

🔹 How it Works:
  ✅ **Re-applies failed patches** before generating AI fixes.
  ✅ **Tries different patch orders** before resorting to AI.
  ✅ **Backs up original files** before modifying them.
  ✅ **Prevents infinite loops** (limits retries).
  ✅ **Logs all rollback attempts** for debugging.

RateLimiter.docstring:
An async token bucket rate limiter.

- Rate-limits tasks to 'rate_limit' executions per 'time_window' seconds.
- Uses an internal queue to track timestamps of tasks executed.
- If tasks exceed the limit, new tasks wait until tokens become available.

QuickFixManager.docstring: Centralizes all quick-fix logic for common Python error patterns.

RuleBasedReasoning.docstring:
Internal rule-based reasoning engine that applies predefined logic rules.

Features:
  ✅ Detects cause-effect patterns.
  ✅ Uses conditional reasoning (if X then Y).
  ✅ Supports rule chaining (multi-step logic).
  ✅ Implements weighted decision-making (probabilistic reasoning).
  ✅ Logs matched/missed patterns for debugging.
  ✅ AI-assisted rule suggestions (future-proof).
